hypothesis: Battery failures include orientation-dependent misses and class confusion. Add exact +/-90-degree image and all-GT-box transforms of all 188 whitelisted hand-held battery train images (376 derived files, two draws each), keeping the targeted-background reference dataset and deployed initialization/scales/3-epoch schedule unchanged. No new objects and no validation-guided selection.
initialization: Current deployed stage4 checkpoint and its exact existing frozen Q15 scale profile; no failed candidate initialization.
frozen: All other parameters, all BN stats/affine, anchors, all activation/preactivation scales and LUTs.
integer_coefficients: Per-output weight scale and Q15 multiplier recomputed from current weights; export uses the same frozen scale profile, no posthoc calibration.
gradient: STE for round-half-away, clamp gradients for saturation; analytic activation for LUT gradient; float64 integer forward accumulations bounded below 2**53.
checkpoint_selection: Final third epoch only, no threshold/calibration/epoch sweep.

acceptance.per_waste_class_subject_correct: at least deployed baseline with same selector
acceptance.public_dev: no worse than deployed baseline on identical 712 images

scope: Offline training/software arithmetic only, no FPGA, synthesis, routing, UART, TF, Flash, deployment replacement or final-test image/label access.
count_note: This experiment adds 376 deterministic orientation augmentations and zero new source photographs. Reference data already includes 40 new source photos and 14 derived empty crops; 8334 cached files is not an independent-photo count.
